items.stem: What is the primary purpose of the S&OP process?

options.text: To align demand, supply and finance into one agreed, decision-ready plan
options.rationale: Correct: S&OP reconciles functions into a single balanced plan with executive decisions.

options.text: To produce the most accurate statistical forecast possible
options.rationale: Forecasting feeds S&OP but is not its purpose; alignment and decisions are.
S&OP informs but does not replace the budget; it is a rolling operating plan.

options.text: To schedule individual production jobs on the floor
options.rationale: That is detailed scheduling, downstream of S&OP's aggregate planning.

items.explanation: Correct: S&OP reconciles functions into a single balanced plan with executive decisions.

items.stem: A demand plan exceeds rough-cut capacity in month 3. Which TWO options could legitimately close the gap? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Build inventory in earlier months while capacity is available
options.rationale: Correct: pre-building uses spare early capacity to meet the later peak.

options.text: Add overtime or a temporary shift in month 3
options.rationale: Correct: temporarily increasing capacity is a valid way to meet the peak.

options.text: Ignore the constraint and keep the plan unchanged
options.rationale: An infeasible plan is not a plan; the constraint must be addressed.

options.text: Lower the forecast to match capacity without reason
options.rationale: Forcing the forecast down to fit capacity hides the real demand signal.

items.explanation: Correct: pre-building uses spare early capacity to meet the later peak.

items.stem: A monthly S&OP meeting ends with a good discussion but no recorded decisions or owners. What is the main problem?

options.text: Without owned, documented decisions the process does not drive action
options.rationale: Correct: S&OP exists to produce accountable decisions, not just discussion.

options.text: The meeting was simply too short
options.rationale: Length is not the issue; the missing output is decisions and ownership.

options.text: Forecast accuracy must have been too low
options.rationale: Accuracy is separate from the failure to record decisions.

options.text: Finance should not attend S&OP meetings
options.rationale: Finance is a core participant; excluding it would weaken S&OP.

items.explanation: Correct: S&OP exists to produce accountable decisions, not just discussion.
